opinions.text:
Application for stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit presented to The Chief Justice; and by him referred to the Court, granted.

Motion to vacate stay heretofore granted by The Chief Justice ' denied. Mr. Justice Brennan, Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. -Justice Marshall, and Mr. . Justice Powell would discontinue the stay.
